critical_code_review_comments: (a) _ensure_indexes in server.py creates 40+ indexes including unique(users.email), unique(users.id), unique(sessions.jti), TTL on password_resets.expires_at, TTL on sessions.expires_at, TTL on deleted_items.deleted_at (30d), and unique(push_subscriptions.subscription.endpoint). Server logs confirm 'Indexes ensured (idempotent)' on every startup.

(p) Router split: server.py is ~782 lines with new routers/seed.py, routers/dashboard.py, routers/i18n.py. All extracted endpoints respond correctly: /api/dashboard/stats, /api/dashboard/action-items, /api/people/stats, /api/parent/dashboard, /api/i18n, /api/i18n/en, /api/webcal/{uid}.ics.

(l) Session manager verified end-to-end: JWT includes jti claim; login calls create_token_with_session (persists user_agent+ip+expires_at). /api/auth/sessions lists sessions with is_current flag. DELETE /api/auth/sessions/{jti} revokes specific session. POST /api/auth/sessions/revoke-others revokes all but current. POST /api/auth/logout revokes current jti. After revoke, /api/auth/me returns 401 with 'Session revoked' detail. deps.get_current_user short-circuits on revoked jti; legacy tokens without jti still accepted.

(i) _fire_birthday_anniversary_notifications: regex-match on date_of_birth $regex -MM-DD$, inserts notifications with kind='birthday' or 'anniversary', ref_member_id, location_id, target_role=None. Scheduler fires once/day at hour==8 UTC (guarded by last_birthday_check_date). Idempotency is soft — if server restarts after 08:00 on the same day, notifications could duplicate; consider checking notifications collection for existing same-day kind=birthday/ref_member_id before insert.

(h) Push: /api/push/vapid-key returns publicKey from VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY env. /api/push/subscribe upserts on user_id (good — one subscription per user/device endpoint). /api/push/subscribe DELETE removes all for user. WebSocketContext auto-calls subscribePush() 2s after connect — cannot fully verify in headless Playwright (browser permission blocks).

(q) MemberForm extracted to /app/frontend/src/components/people/MemberForm.jsx. UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx imports at line 26. Dialog renders with all fields: name, email, phone, ID number, gender, role, group, location, System Admin toggle, date_of_birth (native picker — see design issue), PIN, parent/donor toggles, notes. No regressions.
Minor: SECRET_KEY default in deps.py ('5812global_secret_key_change_in_production') is hardcoded as fallback — production must set env var.

Minor: deps.create_token_with_session 'ip' parsing on line 58 has operator precedence ambiguity — `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') or request.client.host if request.client else ''` evaluates as `(XFF or host) if request.client else ''`. Works but could be parenthesized for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (UI markers and dialogs render; session card + revoke button visible with 2+ sessions; MemberForm dialog intact)
